title: Add queue fallback for payment retries
summary: When upstream payment API errors exceed threshold, requests are persisted to queue for async recovery.
decision: Prioritize successful capture over immediate latency.

title: Centralize retry policy in middleware
summary: Retry behavior moved from handlers into middleware to reduce divergence and hidden behavior.
risk: Incorrect shared policy could affect all services simultaneously.

title: Auth token cache refresh
summary: Refresh window increased to reduce expiry race conditions.
risk: Potential stale-token interval under edge load.
